metadata.label: PIONIER reconstruction
metadata.coverage: One image of the photosphere reconstructed with the public SQUEEZE code from 909 squared visibilities and 603 closure phases measured by VLTI/PIONIER on four nights of September 2014 in the H band (1.62-1.73 micrometres, three channels), convolved to the 2.1 milliarcsecond interferometric beam and cast onto a sphere of the radius the disc and the Gaia parallax imply. The camera is computed: the star has no measured rotation axis, so the display axis is celestial north in the plane of the sky, the display meridian is the sub-Earth point at the epoch, and the pixel scale is the reconstruction's. Nothing finer than the beam is shown. The colours are a legend for reconstructed relative intensity in one infrared band, not colour or temperature. The far hemisphere is unobserved.

reconstruction.filter: H band 1.62-1.73 um, three spectral channels

transfer.interpretation: Trial acceptance bounds, not estimates of source accuracy. A footprint is the pixel's range times its angular size, 9.7 million kilometres at the disc centre from 162 parsecs, so a contributor lies within two of those of the closest sphere point; the one-metre visibility tolerance is numerically zero on a body this size, and the sphere is convex, so no point occludes another.

science.qualification: Uniform photosphere colour from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum. The disc is unresolved: no map, limb darkening or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting.

offLimbContext.source: the same beam-convolved reconstruction: its light outside the 18.17 mas disc on the lens palette and stretch with alpha fading to the background maximum; the plate spans the 51 mas field
offLimbContext.composition: sky-plane image registered to the disc (496 px = 18.17 mas), mirrored and turned to the scene's handedness so its north meets the rendered display axis at the default camera
offLimbContext.rotation: stationary sky-plane context; drawn behind the sphere, so the disc itself is hidden

limbMaterial.composition: transparent: the sphere's own silhouette is the limb; the light just outside it is on the off-limb plate
